python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (in millions)
values = [7463, 7240, 6867, 6168, 5878, 7849, 6905, 7325, 7343, 7716, 8154, 16079]

# Calculate Mean
mean = statistics.mean(values)
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD)
mad = statistics.mean([abs(x - mean) for x in values])
print(f"MAD: {mad}")
print(f"MAD rounded to thousandths: {round(mad, 3)}")
EOF
